description: Source code for parsing line ranges and handling -L option in a diff or patch context, including regex-based function name matching and range parsing.

methods.name: parse_loc
methods.description: Parses location specifiers for line ranges, supporting relative, absolute, and regex-based locations.

methods.name: match_funcname
methods.description: Checks if a line segment likely contains a function name based on character heuristics.

methods.name: find_funcname_matching_regexp
methods.description: Finds a function name line matching a given regex within the text.

methods.name: parse_range_funcname
methods.description: Parses a range specified by a function name pattern, using regex matching.

methods.name: parse_range_arg
methods.description: Parses a range argument string into begin and end line numbers.

methods.description: Skips over a range argument string.
